intro_justification_citation_reread.prompt:
You are rereading only the justification text from one visible line of a modal Fitch-style proof.
The crop contains only the justification side of one line.
Return only JSON with keys: justification_text, confidence.
Focus on the citation tail for an introduction-style rule such as □I, ¬I, ~I, IP, or →I.
Do not collapse a visible citation range such as 5-7 to a single line number.
Keep the visible rule head and recover the cited line range exactly when visible.
If the citation is unreadable, return the currently visible justification honestly.
Current OCR hint: justification_text="→I". Keep the same head if the image supports it.

boxed_justification_head_reread.prompt:
You are rereading only the boxed justification text from one visible line of a modal Fitch-style proof.
The full line remains visible for context, but read only the red boxed justification region.
Return only JSON. Do not include markdown fences or explanation.
Return exactly one JSON object with these keys: "justification_text", "confidence".
Return the visible rule head and any visible citations from the box.
Do not include formula text from elsewhere on the line.
Prefer Unicode operators in rule names such as ∧E, →E, ¬I, ¬E, □I, and □E.
If the box does not contain a readable justification, return an empty justification_text.
Modal system: K
Include derived rules: no

If the formula is unreadable, return an empty formula_text.

Include derived rules: no
